behavior.arguments: rdi = base pointer, rsi = destination pointer. p = [rdi+0x2d8]. When p is null or the gate byte [rdi+0xb8] is 0, nothing is stored. Otherwise [rsi+0x10] = [p+0x20] and [rsi+0x18] = [p+0x60].

edges.copy: p nonzero, gate 1, fields 0x11/0x22 -> stores (0x11, 0x22) in destination order.
edges.field_order: p nonzero, gate 0xff, fields 0x22/0x11 -> stores (0x22, 0x11); the 0x20 field lands at +0x10, the 0x60 field at +0x18.

behavior.entry_shape: Opens with endbr64; two forward branches (both to the ret), no calls: endbr64; mov 0x2d8(%rdi),%rax; test %rax,%rax; je 0x53b1149; cmpb $0x0,0xb8(%rdi); je 0x53b1149; mov 0x20(%rax),%rdx; mov 0x60(%rax),%rax; mov %rdx,0x10(%rsi); mov %rax,0x18(%rsi); ret.
behavior.return_rule: No boolean return is claimed: on the copy path rax ends holding [p+0x60], on the null path rax is 0, and on the gate-clear path rax still holds p. The observable effect is the two stores, or their absence.

coordinate_system: ELF virtual addresses, without a guessed loader or Ghidra rebase. The ELF section table maps .text with file offset = VA - 0x1000; the retained .eh_frame has equal file offset and VA. The tools resolve sections rather than assuming one global VA/file-offset relationship.

incoming_pattern_scan.note: Byte-pattern scan over the full .text section (70,370,352 bytes) for e8 sites whose rel32 lands on the window start; zero sites found. This is explicitly not a complete xref census: indirect calls, tail jumps, and PLT references are out of scope for the scan.
incoming_pattern_scan.relocation_note: One R_X86_64_RELATIVE record in .rela.dyn names this window as addend (full-section scan: 80,022 .rela.dyn + 278 .rela.plt entries). It is reported as a slot list only; no meaning is claimed for the table it belongs to.
